title: External-result attestation

qualification.milestone: fourth CMP-5 integration milestone — authoritative external-result to canonical-work mapping

exit_criteria: trusted external attesters can bind normalized external source result and proof or credit evidence to one canonical external-work commitment
equivalent external source wrappers may map to the same canonical-work commitment
one previously bound source result or evidence identity cannot be remapped to a conflicting canonical-work commitment
identical attestation publication is idempotent and does not create a second attestation identity
untrusted callers cannot publish attestations and only governance may manage trusted-attester status
attester or governance revocation and governance trust withdrawal make attestations unusable for new resolution
zero or invalid source result canonical-work scheme evidence and invalid timing windows fail closed and at least one normalized proof or credit record commitment is required
acceptable attestations resolve exact canonical-work source result and evidence commitments for downstream CMP-5.6 consumption
the attestation layer grants no reward amount eligibility settlement stake slash proof-verification credit-issuance or duplicate-consumption authority
dedicated adversarial tests mechanical verifier retained Compute regressions and exact-head Compute Market qualification pass
